metadata.master_unit: unique emergency episode; one person may contribute multiple episodes per year
metadata.episode_rule: Administrative records are converted to latent unique emergency episodes using pathway-specific repeat-record and cross-pathway allocation factors. Pathway labels identify the final transition/reporting category, not a single-function state: functions may overlap and act jointly within an episode, but each episode receives one final benefit/harm/none mortality outcome.
metadata.implementation_index_rule: The four implementation quantities are nonserial national maturity indices because pathway success is already a conditional local workflow-completion probability after an eligible episode reaches the pathway. Pathway success excludes national population reach, user activation, platform reliability, and receiver-compatibility scale; their geometric mean supplies that separate national maturity adjustment. They must not be interpreted as four independent conditional probabilities multiplied in sequence.
metadata.predictive_interval_label: conditional future-deployment predictive interval under the stated model
metadata.dependence_model: Equicorrelated Gaussian- and Student-t-copula sensitivities jointly cover shared national implementation and beneficial/adverse clinical multipliers as well as pathway-specific episode, success, effect, and effect-presence draws. Low, medium, and high dependence cases are reported; an empirically elicited correlation matrix remains pending.
metadata.copula_algorithm: For each dependence block, latent equicorrelated variables are Z_j=sqrt(rho) Z_0+sqrt(1-rho) epsilon_j. Gaussian uniforms are Phi(Z_j). Student-t uniforms divide the same correlated normals by sqrt(ChiSq_4/4) and apply the t_4 CDF. Separate blocks cover common multipliers and each pathway family: episode factor, relevance, success, benefit-presence probability, benefit ARR, benefit activation, harm-presence probability, harm ARR, and harm activation. Bernoulli indicators equal one when the activation uniform is below the sampled presence probability.
metadata.predictive_count_algorithm: For every parameter draw, K~Poisson(sum_j N_j); pathway counts C~Multinomial(K, N_j/sum N_j), implemented by sequential binomials; affected counts A_j~Binomial(C_j, success_j); and benefit/harm/none counts are multinomial with probabilities Delta_j^+, Delta_j^-, and 1-Delta_j^+-Delta_j^-, implemented by sequential conditional binomials.
metadata.marginal_distribution_algorithm: PERT uses shape 8 with alpha=1+8(mode-low)/(high-low) and beta=1+8(high-mode)/(high-low). Triangular uses the same low/mode/high. Uniform uses only low/high. Bounded logit-normal centers at logit(mode) and sets latent SD=(logit(high)-logit(low))/(2*1.6448536269514722), then clips; nonprobability quantities use a bounded normal centered at mode with SD=(high-low)/(2*1.6448536269514722). Moment-matched sensitivities monotonically affine-standardize each alternative to the PERT mean and SD with iterative hard-bound clipping.
metadata.expert_elicitation: Interim author-specified priors pending independent SHELF/Delphi-style elicitation. No independent expert-panel results are claimed.
